name: Erik Johansson
bio:
Erik's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fuelled by countless hours spent watching rallycross races with his grandfather. He quickly became fascinated by the intricate designs and vibrant liveries adorning the cars. This fascination led him to pursue a career in automotive painting, honing his skills through vocational training and apprenticeships. He joined Arrow McLaren after impressing their head of paint during a guest assignment. 

Erik brings a meticulous and detail-oriented approach to his work. He is committed to achieving flawless finishes and ensuring the team's cars look their absolute best on the track. He believes that a visually striking car can provide a psychological edge, projecting confidence and speed to both the drivers and the competition. Erik stands out through his innovative approach to paint application, consistently exploring new techniques and materials to enhance the durability and aesthetics of the team's livery. He has a reputation for pushing boundaries and challenging conventional methods.

He also has an encyclopedic knowledge of motorsport liveries, which serves him well in his design work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on using only Swedish-made masking tape.
Always listens to Swedish death metal while working.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his workbench.
